1	---
2	title: 'Story 8.3: Profile Name Editing'
3	type: 'feature'
4	created: '2026-11-07'
5	status: 'done'
6	review_loop_iteration: 0
7	context: []
8	baseline_commit: 'dd59fc845883a9e56ace167dadcdb435744ecf50'
9	---
10	
11	<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">
12	
13	## Intent
14	
15	**Problem:** Configurações shows no avatar/name/email (still the Story 2.4 toggle-only stub) and has no way to edit the display name (epic-8-context.md's Story 8.3 scope).
16	
17	**Approach:** Add a profile header (52dp avatar + name/email) above the biometric toggle. A pencil icon switches the name to an inline `AppTextField`; it becomes a check that saves via the existing `account-settings-update` PATCH and reverts to display mode. Tapping away unconfirmed reverts without saving.
18	
19	## Boundaries & Constraints
20	
21	**Always:**
22	- `AccountSettingsDto` decodes `displayName`/`email` too (required strings), full-contract-decode precedent as `DashboardNarrativeDto`.
23	- No new network call: `fetchBiometricEnabled()`'s success branch also sets new `_currentDisplayName`/`_currentEmail` (default `''`) from that response.
24	- New `setDisplayName(String)`: own `_nameGeneration` guard (shape of `setBiometricEnabled`'s `_generation`, kept separate), **not optimistic** — await `AccountRemoteDataSource.updateDisplayName` (`{'displayName': name}`), set `_currentDisplayName` only on success.
25	- Cubit reads `displayName`/`email` from the repository at construction. New state: `isEditingName`, `nameDraft`, `isSavingName`, `nameErrorMessage`. New methods: `startEditingName()` (draft = current name), `updateNameDraft()`, `cancelEditingName()` (no-op while saving), `confirmEditingName()` — trims draft; empty/unchanged reverts with no PATCH; otherwise saves, staying in edit mode with the error on failure (draft kept) or reverting with the new name on success.
26	- Screen: header is the first scroll-`Column` child, above the toggle. `Avatar(size: AvatarSize.large)`, caller derives initials (first letter of first + last word). Name: `textTitleSm`+`colorTextPrimary`. Email: `dashboardNarrativeTextStyle`+`colorTextSecondary`. Icon: `Icons.edit`/`Icons.check`, `dialogIconSize`, `colorPrimary`, in `InkWell`+`ConstrainedBox(minHeight/minWidth: insertionModalTapTargetMin)` (tap-target fix, same as spec-8-2's retry link). Field + check icon in one `TapRegion(onTapOutside: cancelEditingName)`. Field: `AppTextField(controller, errorText: nameErrorMessage)`, no label/hint.
27	- `_announce` fires on a save failure, same `BlocListener` convention as the toggle's error.
28	- Keep `fetchBiometricEnabled()`'s name even though it now also sets `displayName`/`email` — renaming ripples into `main.dart`/`vault_lock_screen.dart` for no functional gain.
29	
30	**Ask First:** None.
31	
32	**Never:** a second fetch for displayName/email; an optimistic flip for the name; persona/logout/delete UI (Stories 8.4/8.5); merging name-edit into the toggle's own state.
33	
34	## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix
35	
36	| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
37	|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
38	| Tap pencil | `isEditingName: false` | Field replaces name, draft = current, icon -> check | N/A |
39	| Confirm, changed non-empty name | tap check | PATCH, saving indicator, success -> display mode, new name | Failure -> stays editing, inline error, draft kept |
40	| Confirm, empty/unchanged draft | tap check | Reverts immediately, no PATCH | N/A |
41	| Tap away, not saving | outside tap | Reverts, draft discarded, no PATCH | N/A |
42	| Tap away, saving | outside tap | No-op, save completes | N/A |
43	
44	</frozen-after-approval>
45	
46	## Code Map
47	
48	- `lib/features/account/data/models/account_settings_dto.dart` (+ `.g.dart`) -- add `displayName`/`email`
49	- `lib/features/account/data/datasources/account_remote_data_source.dart:11-47` -- add `updateDisplayName`, mirrors `updateBiometricEnabled`
50	- `lib/features/account/domain/repositories/account_settings_repository.dart:15-58` -- add `currentDisplayName`/`currentEmail`/`setDisplayName`

## Intent

**Problem:** Configurações shows no avatar/name/email (still the Story 2.4 toggle-only stub) and has no way to edit the display name (epic-8-context.md's Story 8.3 scope).

**Approach:** Add a profile header (52dp avatar + name/email) above the biometric toggle. A pencil icon switches the name to an inline `AppTextField`; it becomes a check that saves via the existing `account-settings-update` PATCH and reverts to display mode. Tapping away unconfirmed reverts without saving.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `AccountSettingsDto` decodes `displayName`/`email` too (required strings), full-contract-decode precedent as `DashboardNarrativeDto`.
- No new network call: `fetchBiometricEnabled()`'s success branch also sets new `_currentDisplayName`/`_currentEmail` (default `''`) from that response.
- New `setDisplayName(String)`: own `_nameGeneration` guard (shape of `setBiometricEnabled`'s `_generation`, kept separate), **not optimistic** — await `AccountRemoteDataSource.updateDisplayName` (`{'displayName': name}`), set `_currentDisplayName` only on success.
- Cubit reads `displayName`/`email` from the repository at construction. New state: `isEditingName`, `nameDraft`, `isSavingName`, `nameErrorMessage`. New methods: `startEditingName()` (draft = current name), `updateNameDraft()`, `cancelEditingName()` (no-op while saving), `confirmEditingName()` — trims draft; empty/unchanged reverts with no PATCH; otherwise saves, staying in edit mode with the error on failure (draft kept) or reverting with the new name on success.
- Screen: header is the first scroll-`Column` child, above the toggle. `Avatar(size: AvatarSize.large)`, caller derives initials (first letter of first + last word). Name: `textTitleSm`+`colorTextPrimary`. Email: `dashboardNarrativeTextStyle`+`colorTextSecondary`. Icon: `Icons.edit`/`Icons.check`, `dialogIconSize`, `colorPrimary`, in `InkWell`+`ConstrainedBox(minHeight/minWidth: insertionModalTapTargetMin)` (tap-target fix, same as spec-8-2's retry link). Field + check icon in one `TapRegion(onTapOutside: cancelEditingName)`. Field: `AppTextField(controller, errorText: nameErrorMessage)`, no label/hint.
- `_announce` fires on a save failure, same `BlocListener` convention as the toggle's error.
- Keep `fetchBiometricEnabled()`'s name even though it now also sets `displayName`/`email` — renaming ripples into `main.dart`/`vault_lock_screen.dart` for no functional gain.

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** a second fetch for displayName/email; an optimistic flip for the name; persona/logout/delete UI (Stories 8.4/8.5); merging name-edit into the toggle's own state.

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Tap pencil | `isEditingName: false` | Field replaces name, draft = current, icon -> check | N/A |
| Confirm, changed non-empty name | tap check | PATCH, saving indicator, success -> display mode, new name | Failure -> stays editing, inline error, draft kept |
| Confirm, empty/unchanged draft | tap check | Reverts immediately, no PATCH | N/A |
| Tap away, not saving | outside tap | Reverts, draft discarded, no PATCH | N/A |
| Tap away, saving | outside tap | No-op, save completes | N/A |

58	    // `State` — if it's already mid-edit on mount (e.g. the user left
59	    // Configurações via the back arrow, which never calls

78	    // `dashboardCubit.load()` unconditionally... so every open is a live

80	    // demand, never stale").

93	  /// spec-8-3 — caller derives initials from the display name (Boundaries):
94	  /// first letter of the first word plus first letter of the last word (a
95	  /// single-word name yields one letter) — `Avatar` itself only renders
96	  /// whatever it's given, uppercased.
97	  ///
98	  /// Code-review patch: extracts each initial via `Characters.first`
99	  /// (Unicode grapheme-cluster aware), not `String.substring(0, 1)` —
100	  /// `substring` slices by UTF-16 code unit, which would split an astral-
101	  /// plane character (e.g. an emoji) that starts a word into an unpaired
102	  /// surrogate half.
103	  String _initialsFor(String name) {
104	    final words = name
105	        .trim()
106	        .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
107	        .where((w) => w.isNotEmpty)
108	        .toList();
109	    if (words.isEmpty) {
110	      return '';
111	    }
112	    final first = words.first.characters.first;
113	    if (words.length == 1) {
114	      return first;
115	    }
116	    final last = words.last.characters.first;
117	    return '$first$last';
118	  }

536	                          },
537	                        ),
538	                      ],

11	class AccountSettingsState {
12	  const AccountSettingsState({
13	    required this.biometricEnabled,

28	  /// own stream by the time this is shown (I/O matrix: "Toggle fails ->
29	  /// switch reverts ... Failure.message shown inline").

32	  /// Review finding: `true` for the duration of one [toggleBiometric] call
33	  /// — `account_settings_screen.dart` disables the `Switch` while this is
34	  /// `true`, so a double-tap can never start a second, overlapping
35	  /// `setBiometricEnabled` call in the first place (the repository's own
36	  /// generation guard is the backstop for every other overlap this can't
37	  /// prevent, e.g. a boot fetch racing a toggle).
38	  final bool isSaving;
39	
40	  /// spec-8-3 — the profile name shown in display mode, read from
41	  /// `AccountSettingsRepository.currentDisplayName` at construction
42	  /// (Boundaries), then kept in sync by [AccountSettingsCubit.
43	  /// confirmEditingName]'s own success branch — never re-read from the
44	  /// repository afterwards.
45	  final String displayName;

48	  /// never written anywhere (not editable — "email is rejected").
49	  final String email;
50	
51	  /// spec-8-3 — `true` while the name is in its inline-editable form (the

53	  /// (draft = current name)".
54	  final bool isEditingName;

56	  /// spec-8-3 — the in-progress edit's own text, separate from
57	  /// [displayName] until [AccountSettingsCubit.confirmEditingName] commits
58	  /// it. Kept exactly as typed (not trimmed) so a failed save redisplays
59	  /// the same text the user left in the field (Boundaries: "draft kept").
60	  final String nameDraft;
61	
62	  /// spec-8-3 — `true` for the duration of one
63	  /// [AccountSettingsCubit.confirmEditingName] PATCH call. Mirrors
64	  /// [isSaving]'s own role for the biometric toggle, kept as its own field
65	  /// (Boundaries: "never: merging name-edit into the toggle's own state").
66	  final bool isSavingName;
67	
68	  /// spec-8-3 — set only once [AccountSettingsCubit.confirmEditingName]'s
69	  /// own PATCH call fails; the field stays editable with [nameDraft]
70	  /// unchanged (I/O matrix: "Failure -> stays editing, inline error, draft
71	  /// kept").
72	  final String? nameErrorMessage;
73	
74	  AccountSettingsState copyWith({
75	    bool? biometricEnabled,
76	    String? errorMessage,
77	    bool clearErrorMessage = false,
78	    bool? isSaving,
79	    String? displayName,
80	    String? email,
81	    bool? isEditingName,
82	    String? nameDraft,
83	    bool? isSavingName,
84	    String? nameErrorMessage,
85	    bool clearNameErrorMessage = false,
86	  }) {
87	    return AccountSettingsState(
88	      biometricEnabled: biometricEnabled ?? this.biometricEnabled,
89	      errorMessage: clearErrorMessage
90	          ? null
91	          : (errorMessage ?? this.errorMessage),
92	      isSaving: isSaving ?? this.isSaving,
93	      displayName: displayName ?? this.displayName,
94	      email: email ?? this.email,
95	      isEditingName: isEditingName ?? this.isEditingName,
96	      nameDraft: nameDraft ?? this.nameDraft,
97	      isSavingName: isSavingName ?? this.isSavingName,
98	      nameErrorMessage: clearNameErrorMessage
99	          ? null
100	          : (nameErrorMessage ?? this.nameErrorMessage),
101	    );
102	  }
103	
104	  @override
105	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
106	      identical(this, other) ||
107	      (other is AccountSettingsState &&
108	          other.biometricEnabled == biometricEnabled &&
109	          other.errorMessage == errorMessage &&
110	          other.isSaving == isSaving &&
111	          other.displayName == displayName &&
112	          other.email == email &&
113	          other.isEditingName == isEditingName &&
114	          other.nameDraft == nameDraft &&
115	          other.isSavingName == isSavingName &&
116	          other.nameErrorMessage == nameErrorMessage);
117	
118	  @override
119	  int get hashCode => Object.hash(
120	    biometricEnabled,
121	    errorMessage,
122	    isSaving,
123	    displayName,
124	    email,
125	    isEditingName,
126	    nameDraft,
127	    isSavingName,
128	    nameErrorMessage,
129	  );
130	
131	  @override
132	  String toString() =>
133	      'AccountSettingsState(biometricEnabled: $biometricEnabled, '
134	      'errorMessage: $errorMessage, isSaving: $isSaving, '
135	      'displayName: $displayName, email: $email, '
136	      'isEditingName: $isEditingName, nameDraft: $nameDraft, '
137	      'isSavingName: $isSavingName, nameErrorMessage: $nameErrorMessage)';
138	}
139	
140	/// Calls [AccountSettingsRepository] directly (no use-case — same small-
141	/// scope rationale `AuthCubit`'s own doc gives). [toggleBiometric] is the
142	/// I/O matrix's optimistic flip/revert, end to end: the repository itself
143	/// flips [AccountSettingsRepository.currentBiometricEnabled] immediately
144	/// and emits it on [AccountSettingsRepository.biometricEnabledStream] —
145	/// this cubit only mirrors that stream into its own [AccountSettingsState]
146	/// (subscribed once, at construction) and separately layers the
147	/// toggle-failure error message on top.
148	class AccountSettingsCubit extends Cubit<AccountSettingsState> {
149	  AccountSettingsCubit(this._repository)
150	    : super(
151	        AccountSettingsState(
152	          biometricEnabled: _repository.currentBiometricEnabled,
153	          // spec-8-3 — read once, at construction (Boundaries); never
154	          // re-read from the repository afterwards.
155	          displayName: _repository.currentDisplayName,
156	          email: _repository.currentEmail,
157	        ),
158	      ) {
159	    _subscription = _repository.biometricEnabledStream.listen((value) {
160	      // Review finding: `biometricEnabledStream`'s first delivery always
161	      // replays the exact same value the constructor above just read
162	      // synchronously — without this check, that replay was a redundant
163	      // duplicate emission (not skipped by `Cubit`'s own equal-state dedup,
164	      // which only applies once something has already been emitted),
165	      // forcing one pointless extra rebuild right after every screen mount.
166	      if (value == state.biometricEnabled) {
167	        return;
168	      }
169	      emit(state.copyWith(biometricEnabled: value));
170	    });
171	  }
172	
173	  final AccountSettingsRepository _repository;
174	  late final StreamSubscription<bool> _subscription;
175	
176	  Future<void> toggleBiometric(bool value) async {
177	    emit(state.copyWith(clearErrorMessage: true, isSaving: true));
178	    final result = await _repository.setBiometricEnabled(value);
179	    // Review finding: this cubit is a `get_it` lazy singleton with
180	    // `dispose: (cubit) => cubit.close()` — if `close()` runs while the
181	    // `await` above is still pending (e.g. `resetCoreDependencies()`
182	    // during a logout, once Epic 8 implements one), `emit()` below would
183	    // otherwise throw a `StateError` ("Cannot emit new states after
184	    // calling close"), unlike the repository-layer `_emit` methods in this
185	    // codebase, which already guard against the equivalent race.
186	    if (isClosed) {
187	      return;
188	    }
189	    result.match((failure) {
190	      // Review finding: a superseded call's `Left` is an internal
191	      // control-flow signal (`AccountSettingsRepository.
192	      // supersededMessage`), not a real error — the winning call already
193	      // settled the value correctly, so nothing should be shown; showing
194	      // `failure.message` unconditionally leaked that raw, English,
195	      // internal string into this otherwise fully Portuguese screen.
196	      if (failure.message == AccountSettingsRepository.supersededMessage) {
197	        emit(state.copyWith(isSaving: false));
198	        return;
199	      }
200	      emit(state.copyWith(errorMessage: failure.message, isSaving: false));
201	    }, (_) => emit(state.copyWith(isSaving: false)));
202	  }
203	
204	  /// Review finding: [errorMessage] previously cleared only at the start of
205	  /// the *next* [toggleBiometric] call — since this cubit is a DI
206	  /// singleton that outlives any single Configurações visit, a failed
207	  /// toggle's error text would otherwise still be showing if the user
208	  /// left the screen and came back later with no new attempt made.
209	  /// `account_settings_screen.dart` calls this once, on mount, same
210	  /// "stale message must not linger unchanged" fix already applied to
211	  /// `vault_lock_screen.dart`'s own PIN-mismatch error, just anchored to
212	  /// screen-entry instead of attempt-start.
213	  void clearStaleError() {
214	    if (state.errorMessage != null) {
215	      emit(state.copyWith(clearErrorMessage: true));
216	    }
217	  }
218	
219	  /// spec-8-3 — tapping the pencil icon (I/O matrix: "Tap pencil ->
220	  /// `isEditingName: false` -> Field replaces name, draft = current, icon
221	  /// -> check"). Also clears any leftover [AccountSettingsState.
222	  /// nameErrorMessage] from a previous failed attempt.
223	  void startEditingName() {
224	    emit(
225	      state.copyWith(
226	        isEditingName: true,
227	        nameDraft: state.displayName,
228	        clearNameErrorMessage: true,
229	      ),
230	    );
231	  }
232	
233	  /// spec-8-3 — mirrors the field's own `onChanged`, kept as the single
234	  /// source [confirmEditingName] reads from.
235	  void updateNameDraft(String value) {
236	    emit(state.copyWith(nameDraft: value));
237	  }
238	
239	  /// spec-8-3 — I/O matrix: "Tap away, not saving -> Reverts, draft
240	  /// discarded, no PATCH" / "Tap away, saving -> No-op, save completes".
241	  /// A no-op while [AccountSettingsState.isSavingName] (Boundaries) — the
242	  /// in-flight [confirmEditingName] call owns the eventual transition back
243	  /// to display mode.
244	  void cancelEditingName() {
245	    if (state.isSavingName) {
246	      return;
247	    }
248	    emit(state.copyWith(isEditingName: false, clearNameErrorMessage: true));
249	  }
250	
251	  /// spec-8-3 — tapping the check icon. Trims [AccountSettingsState.
252	  /// nameDraft] only for the empty/unchanged comparison and the PATCH
253	  /// payload itself; an empty or unchanged draft reverts immediately with
254	  /// no PATCH (I/O matrix). Otherwise awaits
255	  /// `AccountSettingsRepository.setDisplayName` (not optimistic,
256	  /// Boundaries) — success reverts to display mode showing the new name;
257	  /// failure stays in edit mode with the draft kept and an inline error.
258	  Future<void> confirmEditingName() async {
259	    final trimmed = state.nameDraft.trim();
260	    if (trimmed.isEmpty || trimmed == state.displayName) {
261	      emit(state.copyWith(isEditingName: false, clearNameErrorMessage: true));
262	      return;
263	    }
264	    emit(state.copyWith(isSavingName: true, clearNameErrorMessage: true));
265	    final result = await _repository.setDisplayName(trimmed);
266	    // Same close()-race guard as toggleBiometric's own.
267	    if (isClosed) {
268	      return;
269	    }
270	    result.match(
271	      (failure) {
272	        // Same superseded-message filtering convention as toggleBiometric's
273	        // own failure branch — an internal control-flow signal, not a real
274	        // error to show.
275	        if (failure.message == AccountSettingsRepository.supersededMessage) {
276	          emit(state.copyWith(isSavingName: false));
277	          return;
278	        }
279	        emit(
280	          state.copyWith(
281	            isSavingName: false,
282	            nameErrorMessage: failure.message,
283	          ),
284	        );
285	      },
286	      (_) {
287	        // Review finding: reads the repository's own echoed value (set
288	        // from `dto.displayName` in `setDisplayName`'s success branch),
289	        // not the locally-sent `trimmed` string — any backend-side
290	        // normalization (trimming, casing, etc.) must reach this state,
291	        // the one place the user actually sees the name, not just the
292	        // repository's own internal cache.
293	        emit(
294	          state.copyWith(
295	            isEditingName: false,
296	            isSavingName: false,
297	            displayName: _repository.currentDisplayName,
298	            clearNameErrorMessage: true,
299	          ),
300	        );
301	      },
302	    );
303	  }
304	
305	  @override
306	  Future<void> close() async {
307	    await _subscription.cancel();
308	    return super.close();
309	  }
310	}

# Test Automation Summary

## Scope

Flutter/Dart project — "E2E" here means the project's own established
convention of `*_flow_e2e_test.dart` files: the real DI graph (`sl`),
real `Cubit` -> `Repository` -> `DataSource` -> `ApiClient` -> `Dio`
pipeline (both real interceptors attached), with only the transport
boundary (`HttpClientAdapter`) and native plugins faked (no
device/simulator/CI exists yet per AGENTS.md). Playwright/browser E2E
does not apply to this codebase.

Target feature: **export** (story 7.1 — request a period export & job
status tracking), chosen because capture, entries, and chat already had
this level of coverage; export did not.

## Generated Tests

### E2E Tests

- [x] `test/features/export/export_flow_e2e_test.dart` — 5 tests, driven
  directly against the real, DI-resolved `ExportJobCubit`:
  - Happy path: `start()` → genuine `export-summary-create` POST (URL,
    headers, periodEnd bumped to local end-of-day before UTC
    conversion) → real `Timer.periodic` poll loop → genuine
    `export-status-get/{jobId}` GETs → Pendente → Processando →
    Concluído (`ExportOutcome.narrativeReady`); also asserts polling
    really stops once terminal.
  - Narrativa falhou: `narrativeStatus: failed` maps to
    `ExportOutcome.narrativeUnavailable` through the real DTO mapping.
  - Período vazio: `errorCode: EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` maps through the
    real `Failure.fromCode` → `ExportJobState.emptyPeriod()`.
  - Erro: a non-empty-period error code (`AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT`) maps
    to the generic `ExportJobState.error`.
  - Review-patch coverage: `export-summary-create` failing with a
    *retryable* code (`RATE_LIMITED`) is never retried — proves
    `RetryInterceptor.neverRetriedFunctions`' real wiring for this
    function (previously only exercised in isolation or against a fake
    repository, never through the real Dio pipeline).

- [x] `test/core/network/api_client_test.dart` / `test/features/export/
  export_flow_e2e_test.dart` — closed a test-pinning gap flagged by
  spec-7-2's round-2 code review (`deferred-work.md`): the mocked unit
  test now captures the `options` argument to `getRedirectLocation`'s
  `Dio.get` call and asserts `followRedirects == false` and the
  permissive `validateStatus` boundary (302 true / 400 false); the e2e
  test now asserts `followRedirects` on the request that actually
  reached the fake transport adapter, after passing through the real
  header + retry interceptor chain. Previously, flipping or dropping
  `followRedirects: false` in `ApiClient.getRedirectLocation` would not
  have failed either test.

This complements, and does not duplicate, existing coverage:
`export_job_cubit_test.dart` (fake repository, I/O-matrix transitions),
`export_remote_data_source_test.dart` (mocked `ApiClient`, DTO
decoding), `export_status_sheet_test.dart` (widget rendering per
state), and `meus_registros_screen_test.dart`'s "export entry point"
group (tap → picker → `start()` → sheet, against a fake repository).
None of those drove a real network/poll round trip end to end.

### API Tests

Not applicable separately — the backend contract is exercised through
the same e2e suite above (real `ApiClient`/`Dio`/interceptors against a
faked transport), consistent with how every other feature in this
project is tested (no standalone HTTP-level test layer exists outside
this pattern).

## Target feature: auth (story 1.3 — account creation & login)

Chosen because capture, entries, chat, and export already had this
level of coverage; auth (and vault) were the two gaps this same file's
own "Next Steps" section previously called out.

- [x] `test/features/auth/auth_flow_e2e_test.dart` — 4 tests, driven
  directly against the real, DI-resolved `AuthCubit`:
  - Happy path (signUp mode): `submit()` → genuine `auth-signup` POST,
    carrying the anon key as *both* `apikey` and the `Authorization`
    bearer (this function has `security: []` in the contract — never a
    user token) → session pair lands in the real
    `flutter_secure_storage` channel via the real `AccessTokenProvider`
    → the real `SessionRepository` singleton's `statusStream` flips to
    `authenticated` *before* `AuthCubit` emits its own success state
    (the story 1.6 `markAuthenticated()`-ordering boundary) → typed
    password cleared.
  - Happy path (login mode): same assertions against `auth-login`.
  - Email trimming: a value with stray leading/trailing whitespace
    reaches the real transport already trimmed.
  - Failure path: a non-retryable `AUTH_INVALID` (401) surfaces as
    `formError` with `Failure.message` verbatim, status returns to
    idle, nothing is written to the real secure-storage channel, and
    `SessionRepository.currentStatus` is never touched.

This complements, and does not duplicate, existing coverage:
`auth_cubit_test.dart` (fake `AuthRepository`/`SessionRepository`),
`auth_repository_impl_test.dart` / `auth_remote_data_source_test.dart`
(mocked `ApiClient`, the 15-scenario write-failure matrix), and
`auth_screen_test.dart` (widget rendering). None of them drove a real
`auth-signup`/`auth-login` POST — built by the real `UrlBuilder`,
carrying the real anon-key-as-bearer header policy — all the way
through to a real secure-storage write and a real
`SessionRepository.statusStream` flip, in one `submit()` call.

### API Tests

Not applicable separately, same rationale as the export entry above —
exercised through the same e2e suite.

## Target feature: dashboard (story 8.1 — on-demand dashboard aggregation
across entry counts)

Chosen because it's the most recently implemented story (epic 8, the
rest of which is still `backlog`), and — same gap pattern as auth
above — had thorough per-layer and fake-repository widget coverage but
no `*_flow_e2e_test.dart` of its own.

- [x] `test/features/dashboard/dashboard_flow_e2e_test.dart` — 5 tests,
  driven directly against the real, DI-resolved `DashboardCubit`
  (`sl<DashboardCubit>()`, the exact instance `AccountSettingsScreen`
  resolves via `app_router.dart`):
  - Happy path: `load()` → genuine `dashboard-aggregate-get` GET
    (`period: 'all'` query param, real `apikey`/bearer headers) → real
    `DashboardAggregateDto.toDomain()` decode of a 3-bucket JSON
    payload → `ResourceData` with `bucketCounts` in the exact backend
    order.
  - A response missing the required `totals` field → the real
    `DashboardRemoteDataSource` try/catch → `ResourceError
    (MalformedResponse)` (the local decode-failure path, distinct from
    `Failure.fromCode`).
  - A non-retryable `VALIDATION_ERROR` → real `Failure.fromCode` →
    `ResourceError`, exactly one request (no `RetryInterceptor` retry).
  - A retryable `NETWORK_TIMEOUT` → exhausts the real
    `RetryInterceptor` policy (1 + `maxRetries` requests) before
    surfacing as `ResourceError`.
  - Acceptance Criteria ("entry created elsewhere while mounted ...
    chart recomputes"), driven for real: a genuine `entries-create`
    round trip through the exact shared `sl<PendingEntryWriteTracker>()`
    singleton confirms a write, and `DashboardCubit`'s own constructor
    subscription (wired by `registerDashboardFeature()`'s real call
    order in `injection_container.dart`) reacts with a brand-new real
    `dashboard-aggregate-get` fetch — with no test/screen code ever
    calling `load()` a second time. Asserts exactly two
    `dashboard-aggregate-get` requests left through the real transport.
  - **(story 8.2 addition)** A `DashboardNarrativeCubit — spec-8-2
    independent narrative fetch` group, same real DI-resolved pattern
    (`sl<DashboardNarrativeCubit>()`), 3 tests: happy path (`load()` →
    genuine `dashboard-narrative-get` GET, `period: 'all'`, real
    headers → real `DashboardNarrativeDto.toDomain()` decode →
    `ResourceData` with the narrative text); a response missing the
    required `generatedAt` field → `ResourceError(MalformedResponse)`
    (local decode-failure path); a non-retryable `VALIDATION_ERROR` →
    `ResourceError`, exactly one request (no `RetryInterceptor` retry).

This complements, and does not duplicate, existing coverage:
`dashboard_cubit_test.dart`/`dashboard_narrative_cubit_test.dart`
(hand-written fake `DashboardRepository`/`PendingEntryWriteTracker`,
every I/O-matrix transition including the stale-in-flight generation
guard), `dashboard_remote_data_source_test.dart` (mocked `ApiClient`,
DTO decoding for both `getAggregate`/`getNarrative`),
`dashboard_aggregate_dto_test.dart`/`dashboard_narrative_dto_test.dart`,
`dashboard_repository_impl_test.dart`, and
`account_settings_screen_test.dart`/`dashboard_chart_section_test.dart`
(widget rendering against a fake repository, including the
`initState`-calls-`load()`-unconditionally, screen-reader-announcement,
and — story 8.2 — the gated narrative-error-announcement review
findings). None of those drove a real `dashboard-aggregate-get`/
`dashboard-narrative-get` round trip — real URL building, real
headers, the real `RetryInterceptor` policy, the real DTO mapping off
a real decoded JSON payload — nor proved that `DashboardCubit`'s
constructor subscription actually reaches the exact shared
`sl<PendingEntryWriteTracker>()` singleton a real `entries-create`
confirms a write through.

### API Tests

Not applicable separately, same rationale as export/auth above —
exercised through the same e2e suite.

## Verification

- `fvm flutter analyze` — 0 issues (project-wide)
- `fvm flutter test` — **1239/1239 passed**, no regressions in the
  existing suite (story 8.2's additions — the 3-test narrative e2e
  group above, plus the account-settings-screen announcement-gating
  widget tests and the rest of its own unit/widget coverage, plus a
  code-review round adding 7 tests across the narrative cubit/widget/e2e
  suites — account for the +71 difference from the 1135/1135 baseline
  above (review finding: this entry previously claimed a "+24 ... from
  the prior 1175/1175 baseline," an intermediate total this diff never
  actually ran or committed — 8.1 and 8.2 land together in this single
  commit, so 1135 is the only real prior baseline). Story 8.3 (profile
  name editing) then adds its own coverage on top — `updateDisplayName`'s
  RNF09 write-failure matrix plus request-shape/decode tests in
  `account_remote_data_source_test.dart`; the `displayName`/`email`
  boot-fetch piggyback, `setDisplayName`'s not-optimistic success/
  failure and its own (separate-from-the-toggle's) generation guard in
  `account_settings_repository_impl_test.dart`; the full inline-edit
  I/O & Edge-Case Matrix (start/update/cancel/confirm across empty-draft,
  unchanged-draft, success, failure, and the superseded-message
  suppression) in `account_settings_cubit_test.dart`; and the four
  Acceptance Criteria plus the long-name/emoji-initials edge cases in
  `account_settings_screen_test.dart` — 29 tests from the initial
  implementation plus a further 4 from a code-review round (a stale-
  fetch-must-not-clobber-a-saved-name race, the PATCH response's own
  echoed `displayName` winning over the locally-sent value, a long
  (80-char) display name's overflow handling, and an emoji-led name's
  Unicode-grapheme-aware initials) — account for the full +33 difference
  from the 1206/1206 baseline above

## Coverage

- Features with `*_flow_e2e_test.dart` coverage: capture, entries,
  chat, export, auth, **dashboard** (now covering both
  `dashboard-aggregate-get` since story 8.1 and `dashboard-narrative-get`
  since story 8.2's own addition to the same file)
- Still missing this level of coverage: vault (biometric/PIN gate) —
  already `done`, revisit when its own review cycle comes up. Unlike
  the others, `VaultRepositoryImpl` makes zero network calls
  (Boundaries) and already has very thorough mocked-plugin unit
  coverage in `vault_repository_impl_test.dart` (every I/O-matrix
  branch, including two superseded-call races) — the remaining gap
  there is narrower: proving the real DI-resolved
  `sl<VaultRepository>()` and `sl<AccessTokenProvider>()` share the
  real secure-storage channel without a key collision (`vault_pin` vs.
  `user_access_token`/`user_refresh_token`), which no current test
  exercises end to end.
- Story 8.2 (narrative text) now has the same e2e treatment as 8.1
  (see the `DashboardNarrativeCubit` group above). Epic 8 beyond that
  — profile editing, logout, account deletion — is still `backlog`, so
  e2e coverage for those is N/A for now.

## Next Steps

- Consider the same real-pipeline e2e treatment for vault (biometric/
  PIN gate) when its own review cycle comes up — see the narrower gap
  described under Coverage above.
- This entry (story 7.1) predates story 7.2's own e2e additions — the
  `getRedirectLocation` group and the `download` group (`downloadPdf()`/
  `downloadRawData()` through the real DI graph) in the same
  `export_flow_e2e_test.dart`, added across spec-7-2's own commit and
  its code review — have no `Target feature` entry of their own above
  (review finding, code review of spec-7-2, docs/metadata group: this
  file was committed late, as a leftover uncommitted spec-7-1 artifact,
  per spec-7-2's own commit message — nothing has documented 7.2's own
  e2e work here yet).
